dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You fooled everyone in the Central Laboratory.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Yes, and I have to thank you once again. Without your cooperation, which you gave freely, I would have never figured out how to discreetly send that reporter lady packing.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Still, I underestimated Raimondo's perspicacity. I never expected him to be able to uncover the truth, least of all in a situation like that.
